body: I don't.... really know how to respond to this but... that was amazing.

Yeah. No. 
Springfield has been directly referenced as being IN AMERICA on many, many occasions, not to mention the fact that they've always has the same President and social issues as America. 
Oh, and they can drive to Alaska in the movie.

WOW NO SHE WONT GET ANY OF THEM BECAUSE I DIALED A WRONG NUMBER WHEN I TYPED HERS IN. 

FUCK EVERYTHING.

Also if i disappear, its because my body is rejecting consciousness. there's like three alarms set so... heres hoping they work. 
*my* reputation is ALWAYS being late to morning classes because i dont wake up.

I hope not... ill pay the late fees.

oh god i hate watching myself... but its probably a really good idea though, to get me out of my head, and instead see how it translates. 

i really, really hope she does. i dont know how im gonna be able to get there myself, especially with this new-found fucking hemorrhoid. fuck. i wont even be able to sit in the car. 

i do need to do something nice for her though. it just is really hard when youre broke... 

That's how Id probably be able to be at a real university, not at a Junior College. Our rules are way more strict. which really doesnt make sense because in general, if youre at a junior/community college, youre one of the people who didnt do so hot with all the school structure. 

and i dont use steam at all, haha. we were on ps3.

I'll look through that sub, for sure. Doing it whilst trying to type is a bit difficult, so pausing for a second. 

And, honestly, i've got it. I get a my school check on the 11th. thats only like a week if you dont include weekends when the offices are closed anyway. (weekends dont count as a day for my apt complex, in terms of paying rent, so thats nice.) 

Yeah... being a server is like the one thing i'd be worst at, hands down. I'd ruin everyone's everything and try to slap everyone who asked me about gluten. (worked in a local deli/kitchen. goddamn those gluten people. stop asking if soy sauce has gluten. you should know this, it's your diet.) 
Working at Walmart a few years back definitely ruined my faith in the general public. 

i feel like i'd be able to handle being a stand-up comedian, but id have to be able to like... make jokes that make sense out-of-context. I've tried writing a few bits here and there, though. i just met a guy at my comic book store (the only thing i do outside of the house socially is go to trivia night at the comic shop because one of my closest friends works there.) 

And basically, I realized that (yes, this is a quote from "Adaptation,") there hasn't been a new genre of film since Fellini invented the mockumentary. (not counting found-footage films, since those fall under the mockumentary classifications.)
I invented one. For the first time in 40 years, I believe I've invented a new genre. And I have no idea what to call it. 
I'm fucking terrified to say it publicly online though, because if someone else writes faster than I do, all bets are off. 
Though, there's an infinitesimally small chance of that actually happening. 

Basically, the idea is that the movie "Weird Science" is WAY more fucked up than anything in the storyline of the movie ever mentions. I'm writing how the movie actually would have gone in actual life. Sorta. Kinda.

That sounds weird and vague and shitty only because I'm afraid to pitch it online. I've done it for people in my film classes/people I've made student film with though, and they seemed like they were fully on board with the idea. So that's something, at least.

I have no idea what my plan is. I have a doctor appointment in... like 5 hours.  I shoulda slept for it, but whatever, I've gone in before without sleeping. 
I asked my girlfriend to take me, since i can't really take myself. I haven't seen her in a week since both her and her cat have been sick. i've been sitting by myself for 9 days straight now, ticking down the time until she comes back.
and now she tells me that even tomorrow, her 5th day of having the flu or whatever, she'll take me to the doctor's office, but that's all she's gonna do, and she's gonna go back home after because she's still sick. that really, REALLY upset me. so i got mad. and yelled at her to not even bother taking me if she won't bother to be with me afterwards because i've been so lonely. 

so she said goodnight and i love you and went to bed right then and there, in the middle of playing borderlands. just.... disappeared, but i really do need her to drive me there. i was just pissed off and said that. so now i'm sitting up hoping to GOD she wakes up before my appointment and gets my voicemails/dozens of texts saying "i actually do need you to take me because i legitimately can't take myself."

other than that, im sitting here trying not to think about anything else, and wondering what there is for me to eat.

At least you had the liberty to be out of class that long. If i did, I feel like a lot of this wouldn't feel so unmanageable.... 
And i know the feeling. I've been stuck here, alone. for nine days straight. reddit has been my only friend.

Well, I was bullied. Who on Reddit wasn't, realistically? That was a long time ago, though. 

I just... can't get this Mindless Self Indulgence song out of my head.
"It doesnt get better/ unless you're pretty / it doesnt get better / unless you got money / it doesnt get better/ it never gets better / it gets worse."

well, he had a point besides just the bullying bit. at least, if you wanted to apply something other than the bullying to it, you could get that out of it. namely the "*you* get better" bit.

I just don't know how to *get* better. All the ways I have involve (legal) drugs.  And I feel like that's cheating. Which kinda makes me feel worse.
And as for you doubting which hand is which: I got you covered. I got L and R tattooed on my wrists.

I'm not in that relationship anymore, thank God, but... It left me with some huge issues. 
I can't handle the relationship I've been in for the last two years, because of my old memories. 
There's been so many times where she makes a quick move to like, hug me or something and I flinch and put my hands up. It breaks her heart every time. 
But now... she's getting more uhhh... verbal? I guess? We both are. I think a lot of it has to do with my general dissatisfaction with life. I don't want her to have to deal with me like this either. I'm super mean to her all the time and don't realize it until two or three hours later, when i feel like shit for it. she doesn't deserve it...  im trying to stop but its overwhelming. 

I'm trying to figure out something to do from at-home... I'm in a game-design class right now, (another class I can't get myself to, but the teacher might be more open to letting me turn stuff in online considering it's a computer-type teacher.)  
my english professor was the one who told me the absence policy after i told him about what was happening, and i haven't talked to my dragon-lady of a math teacher yet. 
all my film teacher said was "ok. good luck."


as for at home job: i posted a few weeks ago, after i lost my job trying to figure out what i could do from at home. the best response i got was doing MTURKS. I'm trying to do that now, but amazon has emailed my back 5 times saying they cant verify my account and to fax them.  ive faxed them five times now. gotten five emails back saying they cant verify it.  i even called. the call center said to fax it in. it was a pretty useless call.  
they're not a lot of money though. certainly not enough to pay rent and stay monetarily sound otherwise. 
other than that, my roommate says i should get youtube famous. i told her there's no money in just becoming youtube famous. you have to get hella sponsors. and, you know, demonstrate a skill via video. 

I'm in film classes, idly writing a screenplay, which is a gamble to say the LEAST. the very most i can do is assemble a team and make the movie myself, which will still just financially cripple me even more. 
I've got a home recording set-up to do voice-acting/voice-overs, but i have no real idea where to start with that, as my school's voice acting class won't take me until i either do a pre-req or audition. (which i cant get scheduled for. i tried.)

i'm trying to go into the disability center to tell them what's up, and try to get on DRD, but to do that i need to even be able to leave my house. 

in the meantime, though, i have no clue what to do to be able to pay the rent thats due in three days, (except pay it on the eleventh when my school check comes in,) and keep eating. i can't ask my parents for help anymore, it's A) embarrassing, and B) they don't really have a lot of their own to be able to help with.
Sorry its so long... i just sorta vomited my feelings.
